name: After Hours #9 — Night Spin Cycle
description: One machine still working. The rest of the night is a circle of glass and suds. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 9 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 2.4-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
